slot.brief: Indefinite integral of a product requiring integration by parts (log × polynomial or inverse-trig form); identify u and dv correctly.

stem: Evaluate: the indefinite integral of x^3 ln(x) with respect to x is

verdicts.working: By integration by parts, ∫x³ ln(x) dx = (x⁴/4)ln(x) − ∫x³/4 dx = (x⁴/4)ln(x) − x⁴/16 + C.

working:
Let u = ln(x) and dv = x^3 dx. Then du = (1/x) dx and v = (1/4)x^4. Integration by parts gives integral u dv = u v - integral v du = (1/4)x^4 ln(x) - integral (1/4)x^3 dx = (1/4)x^4 ln(x) - (1/16)x^4 + C.

Independent check: By integration by parts, ∫x³ ln(x) dx = (x⁴/4)ln(x) − ∫x³/4 dx = (x⁴/4)ln(x) − x⁴/16 + C.
solution:
Using integration by parts, take $u=\ln x$ and $dv=x^3\,dx$, so $du=\frac{dx}{x}$ and $v=\frac{x^4}{4}$.
$$\int x^3\ln x\,dx=\frac{x^4}{4}\ln x-\frac14\int x^3\,dx=\frac{x^4}{4}\ln x-\frac{x^4}{16}+C.$$
